name: Official Rating Badge
overview: Draws OfficialRating (PG-13/R/TV-MA) as a badge on poster images.
description: Server-side middleware that intercepts poster image responses and draws the item's OfficialRating as a small corner badge. No client-side script injection, no external image service — pure ASP.NET Core middleware running inside your own Jellyfin server.

versions.changelog: Initial release: draws OfficialRating badge on Primary (poster) images.
